behavior: Fixed immutable DAG plans with exact native receipt roles and consumer path/SHA arguments
Dedicated cooperating executor substore, capacity1 or2, global dispatcher lock and durable reservations before prepare/launch
Reconciliation binds plan, effective spec, reservation, result, release and executor terminal; uncertain/corrupt capacity remains occupied
Never-launched preflight failures defer/release without inventing executor terminals; resumption requires new pinned plan and exact original effective spec
Launched retries require new attempt/output and explicit predecessor evidence/reason
Bounded worker may run through separate detached controller executor
limits: Not an installed unattended service or autonomous research, scientific validation, model promotion or publication pipeline
Capacity covers only cooperating queue clients in its dedicated worker substore; current owner jobs remain outside the domain
Native receipt metadata is not scientific qualification; downstream native consumers authenticate scientific transitive evidence
No adoption of existing owner PIDs, automatic retry, changed-spec prelaunch resume, or portable executable-store restore
